source_note: 前立面主照与近侧面实拍互补，绘献殿及钟鼓楼，后方仅绘实景可见后稷楼上檐。通过二次内置生成去除将现代避雷针误读为高耸宝刹的首稿错误，并将后稷楼上脊调整为三座琉璃小塔轮廓。第四参考为本次自生成首稿。主体属清代重建，未混用元代姜嫄殿年代。

Subject: the actual JIWANG TEMPLE, JISHAN COUNTY 山西稷山稷王庙, showing its SOUTH FRONT COMPOSITION: CENTRAL OFFERING HALL (XIAN DIAN), BOTH ATTACHED FLANKING BELL AND DRUM TOWERS, and the UPPER ROOF OF HOUJI HALL behind. Front middle is a THREE-BAY OPEN OFFERING HALL under one broad XUANSHAN overhanging-gable roof, standing on a raised stone podium with THREE stair/ramp parts as photographed: one sloping carved central stone panel between two short stairs. Both side towers each have TWO FLOORS and TWO roofs: a broad lower roof, open square upper belfry framed by posts and rail, distinctive CROSS-GABLED XIESHAN upper roof with several visible intersecting ridges. Both towers are symmetrically placed in front, roofs and pillars separate, do not fuse into central roof. site_recommendation.name: 稷山稷王庙
site_recommendation.yearNote: 所绘献殿、钟鼓楼与后稷楼为清代重建建筑，寺内元代姜嫄殿未绘。
site_recommendation.place: 山西稷山 · 县城西大街
site_recommendation.lede: 献殿与钟鼓楼在稷山城中展开一组玲珑屋檐，后稷楼从后方抬升。琉璃、木刻与石雕共同讲述祭祀后稷和重视农事的地方传统。

facts.label: 清代重建
facts.text: 现存献殿、后稷楼和钟鼓楼属清代，1843年重建与后续修缮留下完整的祭祀建筑组合。

facts.label: 三绝相映
facts.text: 稷王庙以琉璃、木刻、石雕见长，献殿梁枋上的农事雕刻表现耕作与收获。

facts.label: 分清遗构
facts.text: 寺内姜嫄殿等另存元代主体；本图为献殿、钟鼓楼及后稷楼上檐，不按元代着色。
